ecole.heroTitle:
SUP des RH
Training HR professionals since 1998
ecole.heroSubtitle: A school specializing in Human Resources professions, SUP des RH supports hundreds of students each year toward operational HR positions, in France and internationally.
ecole.presentationTitle: The innovative school dedicated to HR since 1998
ecole.presentationText1: Since its founding, SUP des RH's mission has been to train Human Resources professionals across all HR functions and careers: recruitment, training, payroll, skills management, expatriation, labor law, CSR, etc.
ecole.presentationText2: Our human-sized school is committed to training HR professionals by involving partner HRDs and HR managers in the training and assessment of its students.
ecole.presentationText3: In an increasingly connected world, SUP des RH has built an educational project focused on innovation, personalized support, the pursuit of excellence and employability of its students.
ecole.highlight1Desc: Levels 6 and 7 — recognized in France and across Europe
ecole.highlight2Desc: Tuition funded by the company, no cost for the student
ecole.highlight3Desc: 39 rue De Moscou, 75008 Paris + partner campuses in the regions
ecole.highlight4Desc: Symbol of the SUP des RH spirit: curious, tenacious and caring
ecole.pedagogieDesc: SUP des RH has built a pedagogical approach centered on real employability and professional immersion.
ecole.formationsDesc: From Bachelor to Executive MBA, curricula designed for real-world HR, 100% work-study and state-recognized.
ecole.temoignagesDesc: Students, instructors and alumni share their experience.
ecole.ctaEyebrow: Not sure which program to choose?
ecole.ctaDesc: In 3 minutes, discover which HR career suits you and which SUP des RH program is right for you.
